description: Append-only log of BREATHE cycles. Each entry records baseline/post scores, items attempted, skill effectiveness, and discoveries.

failure_reasons.validation_investigation: pathfinder passes individually (5/5 maps OK) but pipeline scorer reports 0% — likely timeout issue in batch subprocess (10s per map). Maps ARE valid but scorer can't confirm in time.

discoveries: Pipeline scorer validation stage runs pathfinder with 10s timeout per map — maps pass individually but fail in batch due to cumulative timeout. The scorer reports 0% validation even for structurally valid maps.
Primitives Lab_Death and Point_Line were missing docs. Transformation Trans_Pit was missing docs. Writing 5 doc files (2 blurb + 3 intent) advanced both sequences from stage 2 to stage 3.
Documentation gaps are the cheapest HEAD to advance — 5 small files move 2 sequences forward.
